title: Account recovery
intro: For Nexotec staff only. Find the account you were asked about by its exact e-mail address or by business, then choose the action from the row menu. Every action needs a reason: it is recorded with your name in the business's sign-in log, which its manager has access to. Nobody sets or sees a password here.

forbidden.title: Not available
forbidden.body: Account recovery is for Nexotec staff signed in with a second factor.

loadError: The accounts could not be loaded.

empty.description: The e-mail address must match exactly. Try the business instead.

reissue-invitation.title: Re-send the invitation to {{name}}
reissue-invitation.effect: A new invitation goes to {{email}}; the previous link stops working. {{name}} sets a new password themselves.
reissue-invitation.done: A new invitation was sent to {{name}}.

reset-mfa.title: Reset {{name}}'s second factor
reset-mfa.effect: Every authenticator app, passkey and recovery code of {{name}} is removed and all their sessions end. Where a second factor is required, they set one up again at their next sign-in.

clear-lockout.title: Clear {{name}}'s lockout
clear-lockout.effect: The failed sign-in attempts of {{name}} are cleared and the lock is lifted. Their password does not change.

revoke-sessions.title: End all of {{name}}'s sessions
revoke-sessions.effect: {{name}} is signed out on every device and signs in again.

grant-manager.title: Make {{name}} manager of {{betrieb}}
grant-manager.effect: {{name}} becomes a manager of {{betrieb}} and signs in again.
grant-manager.done: {{name}} is now a manager of the business.

change-email.title: Change {{name}}'s e-mail address
change-email.effect: {{name}} signs in with the new address from now on. Open invitation and reset links end, {{name}} is signed out everywhere, and {{email}} is told of the change. The password does not change.
